methods.title: Group and aggregate
methods.description: Group all accepted rows by date. Filter matching groups locally.
methods.formula: Sum / average of valid numeric values, or row count, per group.
methods.units: active_users for sum and average; source rows for count
methods.missing: Blank groups appear as (missing). Blank numeric values are excluded from numeric aggregation and counted in exclusions. Row count includes rows with missing numeric values. Search-filtered rows are excluded.
methods.assumptions: No deduplication. Count means source row count, not distinct users. Summing reported active_users does not deduplicate users across records. Dates remain source calendar dates. Search is case-insensitive. Imported types and delimiter are user-confirmed.

files.analysis: export async function analyze(ctx){const s=ctx.sources.find(s=>s.id==='4455a66f-97eb-4852-b492-89adb634ded3');if(!s)throw new Error('Required source unavailable.');const g=s.columns.findIndex(c=>c.id==='c0');const v=s.columns.findIndex(c=>c.id==='c1');if(g<0||v<0)throw new Error('Required columns unavailable.');const groups=new Map();let included=0,excluded=0;const mode=ctx.params.aggregation||'sum';for(const row of s.rows){const key=row[g]||'(missing)';if(!key.toLowerCase().includes(String(ctx.params.search||'').toLowerCase())){excluded++;continue;}const raw=row[v]||'';if(mode!=='count'&&(raw.trim()===''||!Number.isFinite(Number(raw)))){excluded++;continue;}const a=groups.get(key)||{sum:0,n:0};if(mode!=='count')a.sum+=Number(raw);a.n++;groups.set(key,a);included++;}const rows=[...groups].sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).map(([key,a])=>[key,mode==='average'?a.sum/a.n:mode==='sum'?a.sum:a.n]);return {datasets:{summary:{columns:['date',mode==='count'?'row_count':'active_users'],rows,methodId:'aggregate',units:mode==='count'?'source rows':'active_users'}},inputRows:s.rows.length,includedRows:included,excludedRows:excluded,warnings:[],checks:[]};}

files.checks: export function checks(result,ctx){const table=result.datasets.summary;const s=ctx.sources.find(s=>s.id==='4455a66f-97eb-4852-b492-89adb634ded3');if(!s)return [{name:'Required source present',passed:false}];const g=s.columns.findIndex(c=>c.id==='c0'),v=s.columns.findIndex(c=>c.id==='c1');const mode=ctx.params.aggregation||'sum',query=String(ctx.params.search||'').toLowerCase();const accepted=s.rows.filter(r=>(r[g]||'(missing)').toLowerCase().includes(query)&&(mode==='count'||((r[v]||'').trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[v])))));const keys=[...new Set(accepted.map(r=>r[g]||'(missing)'))];const correct=keys.length===table.rows.length&&keys.every(key=>{const records=accepted.filter(r=>(r[g]||'(missing)')===key);const total=records.reduce((a,r)=>a+(mode==='count'?1:Number(r[v])),0);const expected=mode==='average'?total/records.length:total;const actual=table.rows.find(r=>r[0]===key)?.[1];return typeof actual==='number'&&Math.abs(actual-expected)<=1e-9*Math.max(1,Math.abs(expected));});return [{name:'All source rows accounted for',passed:result.inputRows===s.rows.length&&result.includedRows+result.excludedRows===s.rows.length},{name:'Included rows match independent filter',passed:result.includedRows===accepted.length},{name:'Aggregates match independent calculation',passed:correct},{name:'Finite aggregate values',passed:table.rows.every(r=>Number.isFinite(r[1]))},{name:'One output per group',passed:new Set(table.rows.map(r=>r[0])).size===table.rows.length}];}
